verdicts.reason: A keeps the cream circle with the product and the pill buttons, but the circle is jammed into the top-left corner, touching the canvas edges. The subtitle is indented off the headline's left edge, and the right-aligned NEW and Try It stack doesn't line up with the text column. B breaks badly: the cream circle has come loose from the can and sits on top of the 'S' of 'Sunset', so the can almost disappears against the orange background. B's rounded pill buttons have turned into rectangles, and NEW and Try It are staggered at random.
